meta.name: dhdna-profiler
meta.description: Applies the DHDNA framework as an exploratory rubric for reasoning and writing patterns in supplied text. Used for explicit requests for DHDNA, cognitive-style reflection, a thinking-pattern profile, or comparisons of textual reasoning. Scores describe evidence in the sample, not validated psychological traits or personal identity.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读出文字背后的思考方式,给出推理与写作风格的画像
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想用一套结构化框架,读出一段文字里的思考与推理习惯。
copy.tagline_en: Read the thinking behind a piece of text and profile its reasoning and writing style
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a structured rubric to read the reasoning habits inside a text

howto.what: 它会读你给的文本，按 12 个认知维度各打 1–10 分，输出一份认知档案：张力图、主导与阴影模式、推理拓扑、决策指纹和关键引文。
howto.when: 当你要求做 DHDNA 分析、认知风格剖析或思维模式画像，或提供文本想了解作者的推理方式时触发。

say.text: 用 DHDNA 分析这段文字的作者是怎么思考的
say.note: 输出 12 维度评分与认知档案

say.text: 把我和他的文章各做一份档案，再对比两人思维差异
say.note: 进入对比模式，给出趋同与分歧

say.text: 以我们这轮对话为样本，给我做一份自我认知画像
say.note: 基于现有对话评分，并说明样本局限

howto.what_en: It reads the text you supply, scores it 1–10 on 12 cognitive dimensions, and returns a profile: tension map, dominant and shadow patterns, reasoning topology, decision fingerprint, and key quotes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for DHDNA analysis, a cognitive-style or thinking-pattern profile, or hand over text to understand how its author reasons.

say_en.text: Use DHDNA to analyze how this text's author thinks
say_en.note: Returns 12 dimension scores and a profile

say_en.text: Profile my writing and theirs, then compare the two
say_en.note: Runs comparison mode with convergence and gaps

say_en.text: Profile my thinking from this conversation so far
say_en.note: Scores the conversation and notes its limits
